hero.headline: Tonypony's Company shapes spaces from first sketch to final handover.
hero.copy: A fictional full-service studio for thoughtful homes, workplaces, retail interiors, and civic buildings that feel precise, warm, and built to last.
hero.imageAlt: Modern mixed-use building with a design team reviewing plans

approach.title: One coordinated team for design clarity, technical control, and construction delivery.
approach.body: Tonypony's Company is made up for this demo, but the workflow is realistic: site study, architecture, interior direction, permits, procurement, construction supervision, and final styling under one accountable studio.
approach.cardBody: Architecture, interiors, procurement, and site review handled as one connected workflow.
approach.imageAlt: Refined interior architecture with stone, wood, and integrated lighting

services.title: Built around the full project lifecycle.

architecture.title: Architecture
architecture.body: Concept design, planning layouts, facade studies, construction drawings, and authority-ready documentation.

interior.title: Interior Design
interior.body: Material palettes, lighting strategy, furniture planning, custom joinery, and immersive mood direction.

delivery.title: Building Delivery
delivery.body: Cost planning, contractor coordination, site supervision, quality reviews, and closeout management.

sustainability.title: Sustainable Upgrades
sustainability.body: Passive shading, envelope improvements, efficient systems, low-impact materials, and lifecycle planning.

projects.title: Fictional work samples for the demo portfolio.

process.title: Clear steps, practical decisions, fewer surprises.

discover.title: Discover
discover.body: We map the site, goals, budget range, approvals, and must-have outcomes before design starts.

design.title: Design
design.body: Concepts become plans, elevations, materials, lighting, and a coordinated construction package.

build.title: Build
build.body: Procurement, contractor communication, site checks, and change tracking stay visible throughout.

handover.title: Handover
handover.body: Final defects, manuals, styling, and maintenance guidance close the project cleanly.

studio.title: Design-led, construction-aware, client-focused.
studio.body: The fictional Tonypony's team combines architects, interior designers, site coordinators, and cost planners. The result is a calmer project experience where beauty and buildability are considered together.
